timeline.summary: Bharanidharan Pandyan declared no encumbrance on Quality Power Electrical Equipments Limited’s shares for FY 2025-26 as of March 31, 2026.
Quality Power Electrical Equipments received an international order worth ₹48.3 Cr for the supply of High Voltage Reactors for a US data centre project.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹280.81 Cr (+159.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹33.94 Cr (+74.8% YoY).
2026-05-20: Quality Power reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,007 Cr (+157% YoY) and PAT of ₹185 Cr, entering FY27 with an order book exceeding ₹1,400 Cr.
2026-08-10: Quality Power Q1FY27 call reported revenue of ₹256.4 Cr, EBITDA margin of 25.2% and an order book of ₹1,945 Cr, about 1.9x FY26 revenue.
Quality Power issued an EGM corrigendum on October 15, 2026, providing additional pricing disclosures for its proposed preferential issue.
2026-10-17: Quality Power commences manufacturing operations at PCS facility in Niğde, Türkiye
2026-10-20: Quality Power commences manufacturing operations at its new Global Coil Factory at Kupwad MIDC, Sangli, Maharashtra
Special Resolution to issue equity shares to certain selling shareholders of Winwin Speciality Insulators Limited passed on 19 October 2026.
Quality Power submitted an addendum valuation report for its preferential share swap issue with Winwin Speciality Insulators following exchange queries.
Quality Power Electrical Equipments Limited scheduled Q2 FY27 earnings conference call with analysts/investors on 2 November 2026 at 12:30 pm IST.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹272.53 Cr (+32.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹42.44 Cr (+74.4% YoY).
